Transactions on Synthetic Learning 2021;15(4):55-72

Bayesian Optimization for Hyperparameter Tuning in Deep Networks

Mira Patel, Jonas Heller
Synthetic Learning Lab, OrgMentem Institute

Published 2021
DOI: 10.5555/synth.2021.010

Abstract
We describe a Bayesian optimization framework for tuning deep networks.
Acquisition functions and surrogate models are evaluated on synthetic tasks.
Results indicate faster convergence than grid search.
